events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Action needed: migration is paused because phone numbers are being corrupted. Batches 1–3 migrated 120 records; 31 overseas customers have incorrect +1 prefixes. Batches 4–10 (280 records) have not been migrated and would encounter the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the past 24 hours; it is not known whether they used affected numbers. Please alert the sales team not to rely on the affected phone numbers. Recommend identifying the correct numbers from an authoritative source, repairing the 31 records, and correcting and validating the migration process before resuming.
